name: A HERO AND A GARDEN
source:
Once upon a time, there was a princess in a tower.
A brave hero went to save her... but that didn't work out.
He's pretty good at gardening though!

[From [url=https://npckc.itch.io/a-hero-and-a-garden]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，有一位被关在高塔里的公主。
勇敢的英雄前去救她……但事情并不顺利。
不过，他很擅长园艺！

[来源：[url=https://npckc.itch.io/a-hero-and-a-garden]itch.io[/url]]
